_note: ILLUSTRATIVE DATA. Sixteen initiatives invented for the STRATA proof of concept. Money in SAR million. Rules are evaluated by the engine: 'strategic' failures make the initiative OUT, 'capital' or 'dependency' failures make it DEFERRED. Rule expressions use lever ids and engine outputs.

layers.name: Scale-up, geographic expansion and market leadership

initiatives.name: Pricing and contract architecture reset
initiatives.objective: Move key accounts to indexed contracts and tiered pricing
initiatives.rationale: Margin leakage on legacy fixed-price contracts; 60% of lime volume is under contracts older than 3 years
kpis: Contract coverage with energy index clause

initiatives.name: Kiln energy efficiency retrofit, Riyadh
initiatives.objective: Cut fuel intensity per ton of lime by 12%
initiatives.rationale: Riyadh kilns are the oldest in the fleet; energy is 48% of lime cost

initiatives.name: Digital plant and predictive maintenance
initiatives.objective: Raise kiln availability from 86% to 92% across all sites
initiatives.rationale: Unplanned downtime cost SAR 22m in the base year

initiatives.name: Workforce productivity and Saudization program
initiatives.objective: Reach Nitaqat target of 50% Saudization while lowering cost per ton by 6%
initiatives.rationale: Current 41% Saudization is below target band; productivity per head trails regional peers by 15%

initiatives.name: Fleet outsourcing and logistics optimization
initiatives.objective: Cut outbound logistics cost per ton by 10%
initiatives.rationale: Owned fleet utilization is 58%; third-party rates in Central Region have fallen

initiatives.name: Al Kharj capacity expansion, new lime kiln
initiatives.objective: Add 200 kt lime capacity to serve steel and water treatment growth
initiatives.rationale: Central Region lime utilization exceeds 85% by 2028 in the base case

initiatives.name: Dololime line expansion for EAF steel
initiatives.objective: Double dololime capacity to 180 kt for electric arc furnace demand
initiatives.rationale: Steel producers are shifting to EAF, which uses more dololime per ton of steel

rules.label: Domestic demand not in the delayed case

initiatives.name: Red Sea export corridor, Jeddah
initiatives.objective: Bulk export capability of 250 kt per year through Jeddah Islamic Port
initiatives.rationale: Jeddah runs at 64% utilization; East Africa and South Asia lime demand grows 6 to 8% with limited local capacity

rules.label: Export ambition set to GCC plus East Africa and South Asia

initiatives.name: GCC export sales program
initiatives.objective: Road export of lime and GCC to UAE, Kuwait and Bahrain, 100 kt by 2031
initiatives.rationale: Regional buyers import from Oman and Egypt at a landed cost SLIC can beat from Riyadh

initiatives.name: Precipitated calcium carbonate plant
initiatives.objective: Enter PCC for paper, paints and plastics with a 60 kt plant
initiatives.rationale: Downstream margin is 2x lime; domestic PCC is fully imported

initiatives.name: Ground calcium carbonate grade upgrade
initiatives.objective: Move GCC output from filler grade to coated fine grades for paints and plastics
initiatives.rationale: Price premium of 40% for fine grades; Jeddah has idle milling capacity
kpis: Fine grade share of GCC volume

initiatives.name: Water treatment lime and service bundle
initiatives.objective: Bundle hydrated lime with dosing equipment and service contracts for desalination and municipal plants
initiatives.rationale: Water treatment is the fastest-growing domestic segment; service contracts lock in 5-year volume

initiatives.name: Agricultural lime dealer network
initiatives.objective: Build a 40-dealer network for agricultural lime in Qassim, Hail and Al Jouf
initiatives.rationale: Agriculture is fragmented and unserved; low capex, moderate margin

initiatives.name: Acquisition of a Western Region quarry
initiatives.objective: Acquire a limestone quarry within 80 km of Jeddah to secure reserves and aggregates share
initiatives.rationale: Jeddah reserves cover 14 years; Western Region aggregates demand is giga-project driven

rules.label: Domestic demand near plan or better

initiatives.name: Captive lime joint venture with a steel producer
initiatives.objective: 50/50 JV for a 150 kt kiln inside a steel complex with a 15-year offtake
initiatives.rationale: Locks in the largest customer segment and shares capex

initiatives.name: Carbon capture and CO2 utilization pilot
initiatives.objective: Capture 30 kt CO2 per year from Riyadh kilns for sale to food and beverage and PCC
initiatives.rationale: Only viable when carbon carries a cost; positions SLIC for regulated markets and EU CBAM-exposed customers

initiatives.name: Bricks line: harvest and exit
initiatives.objective: Run bricks for cash with zero growth capex and exit by 2029 if margin stays below 8%
initiatives.rationale: Bricks earn a 6% margin on 9% share in a declining market; capacity and management attention are better used on lime
